next.reason: 1985: "The VALUE OF clause for the Relative I-O module is the same as the VALUE OF clause for the Sequential I-O module."; 2023: "No VALUE OF clause in the 2023 file description entry; the candidates (13.4.5) cover BLOCK CONTAINS, CODE-SET, LINAGE, RECORD and REPORT only". VALUE OF was obsolete in 1985 and marked for deletion. None of the 2023 file description candidates provides it, so the clause is dropped.
